name: North Tide's Beachhead
summary: North Tide's Beachhead is a desolate coastal shore in northwestern Silverpine Forest. What was intended as a landing site for arriving Horde reinforcements turned into a disaster when feral worgen overran the small beach encampment.

sections.title: A Disastrous Landing
sections.body: Situated along the mist-draped northwestern coastline of Silverpine Forest, North Tide's Beachhead marks the failed landing site of Horde reinforcement transports. Intended to establish a foothold on the western shore, the arriving ships brought crews impaired by drink who hastily pitched a small coastal camp. Before order or proper fortifications could be secured, feral Bloodfang worgen lurking along the coast fell upon the camp, quickly overwhelming the disoriented survivors and seizing the shoreline.

faq.q: What happened to the Horde ships that landed here?
aliases: why are there worgen on the beach
faq.answer: Two Horde reinforcement ships made landfall here and established a small beach encampment, but their drunken crews were swiftly overwhelmed by feral worgen. A third vessel never made it to shore at all, having wrecked and sunk just north in the waters of the Skittering Dark.

faq.q: Who currently controls North Tide's Beachhead?
faq.answer: Feral Bloodfang worgen occupy the beachhead, having slaughtered the stranded Horde troops and claimed the ruined camp and shoreline as their territory.

faq.q: Where is the third transport ship?
aliases: where did the third boat sink
faq.answer: The third ship foundered just north of the beachhead in the murky waters of the Skittering Dark, leaving its wreckage submerged off the coast.

angles.text: The slaughter at the beachhead is a grim reminder of how perilous Silverpine's untamed coastlines remain, where undisciplined forces can easily fall prey to the beasts stalking the woods.
